backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no methods or logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented frontend changes and associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each key frontend file.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Composes the main landing page layout using Header, Hero, Services, AreasServed, and Footer components.
frontend/src/components/landing/AreasSer: Displays service areas in a bilingual grid with contact info for unlisted locations.
frontend/src/components/landing/Footer.t: Footer with brand info, quick links, contact details, and booking CTAs in bilingual format.
frontend/src/components/landing/Header.t: Sticky bilingual header with navigation links and call/WhatsApp CTAs.
frontend/src/components/landing/Hero.tsx: Hero section with background image, bilingual headings, and call/WhatsApp buttons.
frontend/src/components/landing/Services: Renders five bilingual service cards including sofa, carpet, chair, mattress, and AC water jet cleaning.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages the authenticated or anonymous backend actor using react-query.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication using Dfinity AuthClient, including login, logout, and stored identity restoration.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles and defines OKLCH theme variables for light/dark modes, plus utility classes for text balance and bilingual text.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and the InternetIdentityProvider before rendering.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, typography, animations, and container settings using the custom OKLCH CSS variables.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s current state, requirements, features, constraints, and known issues for building a bilingual marketing website.
